ceiling_source.rule: Not an acceptance of the baseline's intersections or stretch: a ratchet so candidates cannot be worse than the baseline away from the hands. Motions the baseline could not pose, or posed without deforming any skin, have no entry and get the general bound: zero new pairs and the hand guard's stretch limit.
